data.action: 坐在实验台边，外套大衣半褪
data.description: 深夜无人的地质实验室内，外套大衣半褪的艾雅法拉坐在实验台边缘，雪白娇小的身躯在暖黄色的台灯下透着诱人的粉红。她红着脸将头埋进你的胸口——「前辈……实验室的门已经锁好了。听力不好的我……只能通过前辈剧烈的心跳，来感受前辈有多喜欢我了……」
data.lighting: 实验台灯照到岩样盘、册页和两人接触的一边，远处玻璃器皿留冷影
data.nsfwProse: Her lightweight white lab coat is slipped off both shoulders to reveal her ivory lace-trimmed camisole, bare shoulders, short pleated skirt, and dark thighhighs.
data.promptProse: At the end of the lab bench after the last reading, Eyjafjalla sits on the countertop in her ivory knit camisole, pleated skirt and light white coat slipped from the shoulders. The visitor stands close beside the bench, the dark jacket entering from just beside the camera. She rests the side of her face against the jacket at chest height and loosely holds the outer sleeve. A desk lamp pools gold over her loose cuff, the open field log and a tray with two dark volcanic samples. Frame the visible cheek-to-jacket contact and the near edge of the lab bench from the side, with the dim storage shelves and the lock on the lab door farther back.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 夜班实验室
data.animaCaption: Seated on the edge of the late-night lab bench with her white coat slipped down off her shoulders over her camisole, Eyjafjalla presses her flushed cheek against the standing Doctor's dark jacket and lightly grips his sleeve. A warm desk lamp pools over the open field log and volcanic rock samples beside them.
